title: Format time display as hours and minutes (XhMM)

requirements.summary: Update all time duration displays throughout the application to show time in hours and minutes format (e.g., '7h30' for 7 hours 30 minutes), ensuring both the hours and the two-digit zero-padded minutes are always visible
acceptanceCriteria: Time durations on the Dashboard page display both hours and minutes (e.g., '7h30', '1h05').
Time durations on the Calendar page display both hours and minutes.
Time durations on the Reports page (table rows and totals) display both hours and minutes.
Minutes are always zero-padded to two digits (e.g., '2h05' not '2h5').
The shared timeFormatting utility (frontend/src/utils/timeFormatting.ts) produces the 'XhMM' format correctly for all callers.
A duration of 0 minutes displays as '0h00'.
A duration with no fractional hours (e.g., exactly 3 hours) displays as '3h00'.

file_operations.description: Update the formatHours function to consistently format time as 'XhMM' with zero-padded minutes. Ensure hours are displayed as integers (no decimals) and minutes are always two digits (e.g., '7h30', '2h05', '0h00', '3h00'). Update any other formatting helper functions to maintain consistency across all time displays in the application.

Review all time duration displays on the Dashboard page (totals, chart labels, aggregated statistics) and ensure they use the updated formatHours utility from timeFormatting.ts. Verify that all durations are rendered in 'XhMM' format with zero-padded minutes (e.g., '7h30', '1h05', '0h00').

Review all time duration displays on the Calendar page (day summaries, entry cards, dialog displays) and ensure they use the updated formatHours utility from timeFormatting.ts. Verify that all durations are rendered in 'XhMM' format with zero-padded minutes.

Review all time duration displays on the Reports page (table rows, totals row, filtered summaries) and ensure they use the updated formatHours utility from timeFormatting.ts. Verify that all durations are rendered in 'XhMM' format with zero-padded minutes in both the data rows and the totals/summary sections.
